errors.quote: The update costs $O(V)$ whenever the offset takes $b^{O(1)}$ time to compute ..., as a fixed rational linear combination of the controls does.
errors.problem: The 'in particular' claim needs hypotheses the page leaves out. Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams (lines 557-568) requires the rational coefficients to have denominators prime to q, so that they specialize modulo Q at all. It also requires each control used in the offset to have O(b) digits; only then is the linear combination computable in b^{O(1)} time. As written, an arbitrary fixed rational combination of arbitrary controls is claimed to qualify.
